# Sushil Awale > Sushil Awale is a Research Associate in the Visual Analytics Research Group at TIB – Leibniz Information Centre for Science and Technology in Hannover, Germany, and a PhD candidate at Leibniz Universität Hannover, supervised by Prof. Dr. Ralph Ewerth. Since December 2025 also a Research Associate in the Multimodal Modelling and Machine Learning (M3L) team at Universität Marburg. Research focus: multimodal information retrieval for scientific, technical and cultural domains, building search systems with vision-language models for patents and cultural heritage collections. - Role: Research Associate and PhD Candidate, TIB – Leibniz Information Centre for Science and Technology - Location: Hannover, Germany - Research interests: Multimodal information retrieval, Vision-language models, Patent search, Patent image retrieval, Cultural heritage, Bias in vision-language models, Knowledge graphs, Question answering, Natural language processing - Contact: The best way to contact me is through LinkedIn. https://www.linkedin.com/in/sushilawale ## Pages - [About](https://sushilawale.com/): biography, news, selected publications - [Publications](https://sushilawale.com/publications/): full publication list - [Code & projects](https://sushilawale.com/repositories/): open-source code, datasets, demos and tutorials - [CV](https://sushilawale.com/cv/): education and experience - [News](https://sushilawale.com/news/): all updates - German version: [Startseite](https://sushilawale.com/de/), [Lebenslauf](https://sushilawale.com/de/lebenslauf/), [Projekte](https://sushilawale.com/de/projekte/), [Neuigkeiten](https://sushilawale.com/de/neuigkeiten/) ## Publications - [Examining Gender and Racial Bias in Vision-language Models within Colonial Contexts](https://sushilawale.com/publications/awale2026websci/) — Sushil Awale, Omkar Gavali, Ratan Sebastian, Christoph Rippe, Anett Hoppe, Thomas Risse, Ralph Ewerth. DOI: https://doi.org/10.3126/nl.v35i01.46553 ## Code, datasets and demos - [iPatent](https://service.tib.eu/ipatent/): Interactive search system for multimodal patent image search and interpretation, with clustering for exploring results. Live demo hosted by TIB. (PatentSemTech @ SIGIR 2025) Code: https://github.com/TIBHannover/iPatent Paper: https://sushilawale.com/publications/awale2025ipatent/ - [Patent Figure Classification](https://github.com/TIBHannover/patent-figure-classification): Code and the PatFigCLS / PatFigVQA datasets for classifying patent figures by type, projection, patent class and object with large vision-language models, including a tournament-style multiple-choice strategy for large label sets. (ECIR 2025) Data: https://github.com/TIBHannover/patent-figure-classification Paper: https://sushilawale.com/publications/awale2025patfig/ - [CARA](https://github.com/TIBHannover/CARA): Open-source tool for building relevance judgments for image retrieval test collections. Annotators judge pools in groups of similar images, and a built-in simulator compares grouping settings before a study starts. (Software, 2026) - [Colonial-Context VLM Bias Dataset](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19455764): Annotated historical photographs for measuring gender and skin-tone retrieval bias of vision-language models in archival collections. (WebSci 2026) Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19455764 Paper: https://sushilawale.com/publications/awale2026websci/ - [Fusing Vision and Language Tutorial](https://tib-visual-analytics.github.io/Konvens2025-FusingLanguageWithVision/): Full-day hands-on tutorial on vision-language models for multimodal content analysis, with slides and notebooks. (KONVENS 2025) - [DBLP-QuAD](https://github.com/awalesushil/DBLP-QuAD): 10,000 question-answer pairs with SPARQL queries over the DBLP scholarly knowledge graph, for knowledge graph question answering. (BIR @ ECIR 2023) Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7554378 Paper: https://sushilawale.com/publications/banerjee2023dblpquad/ - [Hindi WordNet Extension](https://github.com/uhh-lt/hindi-wordnet-extension): Enriching Hindi WordNet using knowledge graph completion approaches. - [Patent Search on CLEF-IP](https://github.com/awalesushil/patent-search-clefip): Multimodal patent search application demo for the CLEF-IP dataset. - [Biomedical QA](https://github.com/awalesushil/biomed-qa): Information retrieval-based biomedical question answering system using Elasticsearch and BERT. ## Education - M.Sc. Intelligent Adaptive Systems (2023), Universität Hamburg - B.Sc. Computer Science and Information Technology (2020), Tribhuvan University ## Recent news - 2026-10-01: Our panel Photographs from Colonial Contexts in Cultural Heritage Collections. AI-Supported Approaches to Sensitive Image and Text Contents was accepted at the DHD 2027 conference (Digital Humanities im deutschsprachigen Raum). - 2026-06-01: Our paper Examining Gender and Racial Bias in Vision-language Models within Colonial Contexts (Awale et al., WebSci 2026) wins Best Poster Paper Award at ACM Web Science Conference 2026. - 2026-05-01: Our paper Examining Gender and Racial Bias in Vision-language Models within Colonial Contexts (Awale et al., WebSci 2026) accepted as poster paper at ACM Web Science Conference 2026. - 2025-12-01: Started as Research Associate in the Multimodal Modelling and Machine Learning (M3L) team at Universität Marburg, alongside my position at TIB. - 2025-09-09: Presented a hands-on full-day tutorial with Eric Müller-Budack titled Fusing Vision and Language: A Tutorial on Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Content Analysis at KONVENS 2025 - Conference on Natural Language Processing in Hildesheim, Germany.
